reason: The goal asks what the lane-born stars do in the returning galaxy, making its stellar outskirts the clearest destination.

choice.combine: Young stars from the dark lane
choice.with: Stellar outskirts of the returning galaxy

expectation: The stars will pass through the returning galaxy, with their paths altered by gravity.

effect: The stars passed through the returning galaxy with altered paths, completing the goal and confirming the contrast with their parent gas clouds.
reaction: The contrast was satisfying, though the outcome was largely expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Sending the lane-born stars into the returning galaxy was worthwhile because it brought their history back to the contrast between stellar and gas encounters.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter had only one gameplay decision, so there was little opportunity to explore alternatives.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the stars passing without crushing together was what I expected.

arbitrary.text: The chosen action had a clear purpose given the goal and destination; nothing felt arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and see how the shared stellar body develops, though this short chapter offered little gameplay variety.
